name: AlphaFold 3
one_liner: Diffusion-based biomolecular structure generator whose samples are ranked by a confidence formula with clash, disorder and chirality terms.

loop.proposes: A Pairformer trunk and 3D atomic diffusion module generate joint all-atom coordinates for proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, and ions.
loop.judged_by: Samples are ranked by a formula of the model pTM and ipTM with clash, disorder and chirality terms; nothing is filtered out.
loop.steers: Confidence ranking picks the top sample across diffusion rollouts; cross-distillation is a training-data step.

headline_result: Achieved 76.4% PoseBusters accuracy on protein-ligand complexes, far surpassing classical physics-based docking tools.
caveat: Can hallucinate spurious secondary structure in disordered regions or produce occasional stereochemical clashes when diffusion samples conflict.
beyond_harness_note: An all-atom SE(3) diffusion generator produces biomolecular complexes that are ranked by a confidence formula with clash, disorder and chirality terms.
algorithmic_authority: Ranking formula of pTM and ipTM with clash, disorder and chirality terms

sources.title: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3 (Nature, 2024)

verification.notes: Checked against Abramson et al., Nature 630, 2024.
